name: Verdant Sigil
summary: A summons reaches newly awakened night elf druids in Shadowglen. Conservator Ilthalaine passes the Verdant Sigil to fledgling shapeshifters, directing them to Mardant Strongoak within Aldrassil. The token marks the start of their formal training in nature and the Emerald Dream.

sections.title: A Call to the Boughs
sections.body: When a young night elf shows promise in keeping Shadowglen's balance, the order calls for a formal introduction. A runner brings the Verdant Sigil to Conservator Ilthalaine, who entrusts it to the initiate. The token shows that the circle in Aldrassil has taken notice and invites the young druid to begin formal training.

sections.title: Communion and the Dream
sections.body: Presenting the sigil to Mardant Strongoak inside Aldrassil brings the initiate into the fold. Deeper communion with the Emerald Dream and mastery of animal forms lie ahead. For now, Mardant becomes their first guide, teaching them to read nature's spirits and channel the raw power of the woods.

faq.answer: It is an inscribed summons that Conservator Ilthalaine delivers on Mardant Strongoak's behalf, calling a novice druid to begin formal training inside Aldrassil.

faq.q: Where do I take the Verdant Sigil?
faq.answer: Bring it to Mardant Strongoak, the druid trainer within Aldrassil, the great barrow-tree at the heart of Shadowglen.

faq.q: Why does Mardant mention the Emerald Dream?
faq.answer: Druids draw power and wisdom from the Emerald Dream through long sleeping trances. A novice is not ready to wander the Dream freely, but Mardant names it as a mystery they will study in time.

faq.q: Who sends the sigil to Ilthalaine?
faq.answer: A messenger sent by Mardant Strongoak brings the sigil to Conservator Ilthalaine, so she can place it in the hands of a promising young druid.

faq.q: What happens after presenting the sigil?
faq.answer: Mardant Strongoak becomes your primary mentor in Shadowglen, where you learn your earliest druidic spells and magical techniques as you grow in power.
No. The Verdant Sigil is meant only for night elf druids beginning their journey in Shadowglen. Other classes receive their own summons to their trainers.

angles.text: As a druid, this marks your formal initiation into the Cenarion circle's teachings under Mardant Strongoak, beginning the long path toward understanding the Emerald Dream.
As a night elf, you enter an ancient tradition: presenting this sigil at Aldrassil is your first step into druidism, deeply woven into your culture.
